# 🛎️ GitHub files

- 🪟 `workflows/windows.yml` tests the app, builds Windows x64 files, checks the MSI, and publishes tagged releases.
- 🐞 `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug.yml` asks for enough detail to repeat a bug.
- 🌱 `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature.yml` asks what a new feature should help with.
- 🔀 `PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` keeps review notes short and testable.
